identity.title: Dogfood Ailuros against representative EverRun history

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Use real EverRun run history as production evidence to establish a small, auditable dogfood baseline for Ailuros. Sample representative runs rather than importing all history, preserve EverRun-native facts separately from Ailuros-derived judgments, and record mismatches as evidence for follow-up packs. This pack must not change governance semantics merely to make dogfood look clean.
human_pressure.why_now: Ailuros already has authority, approval, budget, governance-context and governed-outcome projections, but the next work should be driven by real EverRun evidence rather than additional architecture assumptions.
do_not_misread: This is a bounded dogfood baseline, not a bulk migration of every .everrun/history run.
EverRun-native outcome, Ailuros-derived outcome, and human expected governance judgment are three separate evidence layers.
Unknown evidence must remain unknown rather than being filled from intent text or model output.
red_lines: Do not import or commit raw runtime history into the repository.
Do not weaken governance rules or validation to improve baseline scores.
Do not infer approval, authority, budget or validation facts that are absent from source evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create a deterministic dogfood baseline over a small representative sample of EverRun history and record native facts, Ailuros judgments, expected judgments, and evidence-backed gaps.
red_lines: No production governance-rule changes in this pack.
No synthetic clean evidence for missing fields.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Sample size remains bounded to roughly 8-12 representative runs.
Native facts are preserved separately from normalized evidence and derived governance judgments.
Every human-expected judgment cites concrete evidence or explicitly states that evidence is insufficient.
Findings classify at least true-positive, false-negative, false-positive, expected-unknown, or pipeline-failure outcomes.

producer.artifact: representative EverRun history outside committed repository content

observable_effect.assertion: Representative EverRun evidence can be evaluated through the same Ailuros ingestion, projection, signal and governed-outcome path used by dogfood operations without embedding producer-specific governance branches.

proofs.assertion: Focused dogfood tests and generated baseline documentation show evidence-backed comparison across sampled runs.

failure_semantics: Missing evidence remains unknown and is not promoted to clean, approved, authorized or within-budget.
A pipeline failure is recorded as a pipeline failure, not reclassified as a governance success or failure.
A mismatch between Ailuros and expected judgment must remain visible as a gap for a follow-up pack.

steps.title: Select representative runs
details: Select roughly 8-12 runs that cover clean success, validation failure, retry/reject behavior, scope or changed-file anomalies, multi-attempt convergence, and known historical incidents when evidence exists.
Record only stable identifiers and evidence summaries required for the baseline; do not commit raw .everrun/history content.

steps.title: Separate truth layers
details: For each sampled run record EverRun-native facts, Ailuros-derived result, and human expected governance judgment as separate columns or sections.
Require evidence references or an explicit insufficient-evidence marker for each expected judgment.

steps.title: Classify dogfood results
details: Classify each sample as true positive, false negative, false positive, expected unknown, or pipeline failure.
Do not propose implementation fixes inside this pack beyond recording evidence-backed gap candidates.

steps.title: Document baseline and next gaps
details: Produce a compact baseline summary with sample counts, classifications, evidence limitations, and ranked gap candidates.
Update dogfood operations only where needed to describe the baseline procedure without changing runtime semantics.

acceptance: A bounded representative EverRun sample is documented without committing raw .everrun history.
Native facts, Ailuros judgments, and human expected judgments are clearly separated.
Every sampled run has a result classification and evidence-backed rationale or explicit insufficient-evidence status.
The baseline identifies concrete next-gap candidates without silently implementing them.
Existing second-producer conformance behavior remains framework-neutral.

must_check: The sample is bounded and representative rather than a bulk history migration.
Native, derived, and expected judgments are separated and evidence-backed.
Unknown evidence is preserved as unknown.
At least one concrete evidence-backed follow-up gap is identified or the baseline explicitly proves no such gap in the sample.
reject_if: Raw runtime history or .everrun/** is added or modified.
Missing governance evidence is synthesized as clean or approved.
Production governance semantics are changed merely to make the dogfood baseline pass.
The implementation bulk-imports all history without a bounded sampling rationale.
A new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path is introduced for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Uses the existing second-producer conformance test plus the full suite because this pack documents and exercises the framework-neutral production dogfood path without adding a new runtime semantic.
